verdict.rationale: Motion has a documented REST API with reference docs and cookbooks, confirmed live and enforcing auth in a runtime probe, which supports building integrations. However, there's no evidence of official language-specific SDKs (e.g., Python, JS/TS client libraries) beyond a bare REST API reference — 'SDK' implies more than raw HTTP endpoints. missing for 10: official first-party SDK packages/client libraries in specific languages, versioned SDK release notes, independent developer confirmation of SDK usage.
